court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Pune, in Petition No. A-914 of 2016
case_name: Trambak Natha Bhagwat vs Shweta Trambak Bhagwat
facts_of_case: The petition is dismissed by the Family Court along with the counterclaim filed by the respondent, and hence the present Appeal is filed.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to explain and justify the delay in filing an appeal.
legal_principles.held: Apart from the ground that the Applicant's father was seriously ill, the Application also proceed to state that he was appointed on Election Duty by order dated 25.09.2024, and he was assigned the duty at Kothrud Constituency Pune, and this also added to the delay in filing of the Appeal.

legal_principles.principle: The court may condone a delay in filing an appeal if the applicant provides a reasonable explanation for the delay.
legal_principles.held: We have heard the learned counsel for the Applicant and perused the Application, which offered an explanation to the delay that is caused.

outcome.final_order: Interim Application No. 2048 of 2025 is made absolute in terms of prayer clause (a). The Family Court Appeal is directed to be listed for hearing on 13.02.2026.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for marriage dissolution
responding to a counterclaim in a family court case
seeking condonation of delay in filing an appeal
